decisions.topic: Factor B Score Floor — Minimum 2 Points to Prevent Complete Clamp Override

vote.fund_manager: Y
vote.research: Y
vote.quant: Y
vote.da: Y

decisions.outcome_rationale: Confirmed double-penalty bug: when dist_days >= 5, Factor B scores 0/20 AND the score clamp forces effective_score <= 39 (Distribution). Today's example: without clamp, effective_score = 47 (Sideways). With clamp = 39 (Distribution). The clamp's intent is a safety override — keeping it is correct. But Factor B scoring 0 becomes irrelevant once the clamp activates, and 0 pts on a 20-pt factor leaves no room for improving breadth to move the score. Fix: floor Factor B at 2 pts (dist_days >= 6) and 5 pts (dist_days = 5). The clamp still enforces Distribution at 5+ dist days — the floor only ensures other factors can nudge toward the Sideways border as conditions improve.

decisions.topic: Monster of the Week — Automated Deep Research and Telegram Feature — CONDITIONAL APPROVED

vote.fund_manager: CONDITIONAL APPROVE — genuine investment value for conviction building and regime-change readiness. Conditions: (1) hybrid cadence (event-driven in Markup, weekly prep brief in Distribution), (2) 3-message Telegram thread not 5-8, (3) pipeline data displayed as-is from system not reinterpreted by research agent, (4) bear case must name a specific price level where thesis is wrong.

No simpler approach captures the same conviction-building value. One-sentence description: passes simplicity test.
vote.quant: CONDITIONAL APPROVE — Score 14/20. Formula flaw identified: ADTV rewards large-cap stocks (anti-correlated with 10x potential). For weekly research selection specifically, a separate select_for_research() function is needed with market cap inverse weighting. Informational feature exempt from standard N>=20 backtest gate. Track research quality via post-mortem linkage after N=10 briefs.
vote.da: CONDITIONAL APPROVE — Complexity: Medium. Data quality issues are known and in fix queue. Pipeline covers 4 of 9 content items. Conditions: selector must be regime-aware, earnings date check required in formatter, fallback if research agent fails, Sunday scheduling via day-of-week check in existing runner.

decisions.rationale: All four members approve conditionally. This is a MEDIUM complexity informational feature with clear practitioner precedent (IBD Stock Spotlight format), sufficient data infrastructure, and genuine investment value in three areas: conviction building before Mode B entries, regime-change readiness during Distribution, and thesis tracking over time. The proposal is sound in concept with four specific conditions that must be implemented correctly. The Quant identified a structural formula flaw (ADTV anti-correlates with 10x probability) that requires a separate select_for_research() function distinct from the daily trading ranking. The DA confirmed pipeline covers 4 of 9 content items — the research agent handles the remaining 5. Cost: negligible (~$5-8/year for Claude API calls). No backtest gate applies to informational features. The feature does NOT trigger any mechanical position sizing or entry decision — it is research output only.
conditions: CONDITION-1: Hybrid cadence — event-driven in Markup regime (fires when ticker first appears in candidates[]), weekly Sunday prep in Distribution/Sideways/Markdown regimes. Fixed Sunday-only cadence rejected by Fund Manager.

CONDITION-2: 3-message Telegram format maximum. Message 1: setup (breakout type, base, RS, theme, entry zone, stop). Message 2: thesis (company one-liner, catalyst, path to 10x, revenue inflection). Message 3: risk (bear case with specific price level, historical precedent, conviction score).

CONDITION-3: Pipeline data (RS percentile, base count, revenue inflection label, conviction score) displayed as-is from candidates.json and earnings_inflection.json. Research agent ADDS narrative around these numbers — does NOT recalculate or override them.

CONDITION-4: Bear case must include a specific price level (not generic). Example: 'Thesis wrong if: (1) revenue growth decelerates below 15% for 2 consecutive quarters, (2) stock closes below $X.XX (50DMA) on high volume.' Generic bears like 'competition could emerge' are not actionable.

CONDITION-5: Separate select_for_research() function with market cap inverse weighting. Small cap (<$2B) = +5pts, mid cap ($2B-$10B) = +3pts, large cap (>$10B) = 0pts. Reduce ADTV weight from 5pts max to 2pts max. This prevents LRCX/ASML (large cap, low 10x probability) from ranking above RGTI/QBTS (small cap, high asymmetry) in the weekly research selection.

CONDITION-6: Regime-aware selector. In Distribution/Sideways: use watch_queue[], label brief 'PREPARATION BRIEF — not actionable until regime clears (bigshot_ok=False)'. In Markdown: still run, label 'MARKDOWN REGIME — research only'. In Markup: use candidates[] if non-empty.
CONDITION-7: Earnings gate in formatter — flag (not block) if earnings within 7 trading days. Prominently note: 'EARNINGS IN X DAYS — wait for print or reduce size to 2.5%.'

CONDITION-8: Fallback mechanism. If research agent fails or web search returns insufficient data, send plain-text brief using structured pipeline data only (no blank sections). Label: 'Research limited — automated sources returned insufficient data. Manual review recommended.'
decisions.what_is_built: 4-component pipeline: (1) monster_of_week_selector.py — regime-aware picker with separate select_for_research() formula including market cap inverse weighting. (2) monster_deep_research agent — Claude Sonnet subagent with web search + FMP profile + Finnhub news + EDGAR context. Outputs structured research JSON. (3) monster_telegram_formatter.py — 3-message Telegram format using Markdown. (4) Scheduling via day-of-week check inside existing pre_market_runner.py (Option A). Sunday run = normal daily run + MOTW step.
decisions.what_is_not_built: This feature does NOT auto-execute any trades. It does NOT override candidates.json scores. It does NOT replace the daily A07 Monster Scout run. The brief is READ by CIO before placing a Mode B entry — the human decision layer is preserved.

vote.quant: APPROVE design — cannot backtest exit rules with N=0. Flag all behavior-based exits as HYPOTHESIS. Mechanical ladder is a known (if suboptimal) baseline. Behavior-based exits require defining exact thresholds for: (a) 'RS line breaks' = rs_line < rs_line_10d_ago for N consecutive days? (b) '10-week MA on high volume' = weekly close < 10wma AND weekly volume > 1.5x avg? Define these precisely so they are testable.
vote.da: APPROVE — implement in A09. RS line break: need rs_line field from BOA-009 (ohlcv.db computable). 10-week MA: computable from existing weekly OHLCV. Climax action: A08 exhaustion signals already computed. Regime detection: A01 already provides regime field.

decisions.rationale: 4/4 approve the dual-regime approach. MARKUP: stocks should be sold when they ACT wrong, not when they hit a mathematical target. The profit ladder was designed for capital protection, not for running winners — wrong tool in a bull market. DISTRIBUTION: mechanical ladder is correct because protecting gains matters more than maximizing them in a weakening market. 8-week hold exception (DEC-011) integrates directly — a monster stock in its hold window suppresses ALL profit ladder signals regardless of regime.
decisions.implementation: See CLAUDE.md updated selling rules. A09 code changes assigned as BOA-008-A1. Behavior-based exits require BOA-009 RS line data first.
decisions.backtest_gate: HYPOTHESIS — all behavior-based exits until N>=20 closed positions. Mechanical ladder baseline maintained as fallback for Distribution regime.

decisions.topic: RS Line Direction Tracking — Add rs_line and rs_line_new_high to daily screening

vote.fund_manager: APPROVE — RS line at new high is the single most reliable Grade A qualifier that AlphaAbsolute is missing. IBD prints this in every chart. Minervini checks it on every entry. A stock can have RS percentile=85 but RS line declining (stock is strong but getting weaker vs market). The RS LINE direction shows trajectory, not just level.
vote.research: APPROVE — IBD methodology: RS line = stock weekly close / S&P 500 weekly close. Plotted as a line. For a proper breakout: RS line should be at or near new highs AT THE TIME OF BREAKOUT — ideally making a new 52-week high on the same day the stock breaks out. This is the IBD 'RS line leads price' concept. Minervini: 'I never buy a stock where the RS line is not confirming the price action.'
vote.quant: APPROVE — computable from existing ohlcv.db. rs_line = close / spy_close (daily). rs_line_52w_high = max rs_line over 252 days. rs_line_near_high = rs_line >= rs_line_52w_high * 0.97 (within 3%). Can compute for all screened tickers in a single SQL loop. Requires SPY daily close in ohlcv.db (likely already present as benchmark).
vote.da: APPROVE — implementation: add rs_line and rs_line_52w_high to ticker_meta or screening_results table. Compute daily in pipeline_metrics.py or trend_template_screener.py. Surface in A08 Grade A check and in session_start summary. Easy complexity.

decisions.rationale: 4/4 approve. RS line direction is the most computationally accessible missing signal. It uses existing data (stock close / SPY close) with no new API calls. Grade A setup should prefer rs_line_near_high=true — stocks where RS line leads or confirms the price breakout have significantly higher success rates (IBD research: ~30% better outcomes vs RS line lagging). Not a hard gate — a Grade A bonus signal.
decisions.implementation: Add rs_line_daily = close / spy_close to screening. rs_line_52w_high, rs_line_near_high (within 3% of 52W high), rs_line_direction (slope over 20 days). Surface in A08 output and session_start leaders list.
decisions.backtest_gate: HYPOTHESIS — add as Grade A bonus field. Measure hit rate difference between rs_line_near_high=true vs false when N>=20 Grade A entries.

decisions.topic: 8-Week Hold as Monster Scout Signal — Rapid Breakout Confirmation adds to A07 and A08

vote.cio: APPROVE — the signal that triggers the 8-week hold (+20% in 3 weeks from breakout) is itself a Monster fingerprint. Apply in 3 contexts: (1) A09: suppress profit ladder for existing holders (DEC-011, done). (2) A07: scan for stocks in Rapid Breakout phase (1-6 weeks from breakout, +20%+ from pivot) as secondary entry candidates on EMA pullback. (3) A08: EMA pullback during monster window = add signal (not new entry), size = 50% of original position.

decisions.rationale: The +20% in 3 weeks signal is a Monster Stock fingerprint — stocks in this phase are in active institutional accumulation. Three applications: (1) A09 hold rule (already implemented). (2) A07 'Rapid Breakout' scanner — finds stocks currently in their monster momentum window for secondary entries. These are REAL Mode B candidates because they are demonstrating exceptional strength. Filter: breakout was 1-6 weeks ago, gain from pivot ≥ 20%, still above 10EMA, volume pattern still accumulating. (3) A08 'EMA_HOLD' setup — when a position (already in paper portfolio) pulls back to 10EMA during its 8-week window, A08 flags it as 'pyramid add' with size 50% of original. Not a new entry — an add to a confirmed monster.
decisions.implementation: A07: add rapid_breakout_scan() function. A08: if ticker is in paper portfolio AND in 8-week hold window AND touching 10EMA → setup_type='EMA_HOLD', recommended_size_pct=5 (50% of original 10%), note='8-week hold add'. CLAUDE.md updated.
decisions.backtest_gate: HYPOTHESIS — track success rate of secondary entries in monster window when N>=10 such events.
